batchId.description: Unique batch identifier, used as artifact filename suffix

mode.description: Dispatch mode: gather=haiku extraction, synth=sonnet reasoning, full=legacy

target_model_ids.description: Model IDs this batch is responsible for

idea_context_path.description: Path to the per-batch ctx JSON file (.aicodermap-ctx-<batchId>.json)

wallclock_deadline_unix.description: Unix epoch seconds. Agent must emit before this time.

agent_budget_buffer.description: Maximum tool calls for this dispatch

require_priority_first.description: Agent should resolve priorityCells before sweeping remaining slice

require_full_matrix.description: Agent must attempt every (modelId, benchKey) in its slice

synth_input_paths.description: Gather artifact paths for synth mode

retry_of.description: Original batchId this dispatch is retrying

reason.description: Human-readable escalation reason (e.g. haiku gather avg_obs < 3)
